newsitem.title: JAPAN: Yuasa forms battery venture in China.
newsitem.headline: Yuasa forms battery venture in China.

text.p: Yuasa Corp said it has formed a company in China to produce batteries for cars, computers and other products.

Guandong Yuasa Sunny Batteries Co Ltd, capitalised at about 1.27 billion yen, is 51 percent by Yuasa's Singapore unit Yuasa Holding Pte Ltd, Yuasa said in a statement. The rest is owned by a Chinese partner, Yuasa said.
The new company is located in Shunde in Guandong Province and it will start operations in July 1997, it said.

In the initial year of operation, the new company will produce 110,000 units of car batteries and 1.4 million units of valve regulated lead-acid batteries used for computers, security equipment and other products, Yuasa said.
Sales are expected at about 690 million yen in the initial year of operation, Yuasa said.
